uncertain: Board identity: the image is a cropped rear-side photo with no product name printed; only the silkscreen (Usr, Mute, RGB buttons/LEDs) is visible, so it cannot be confirmed from the image that it shows the 'reSpeaker Lite' product.
Bottom pads: the 5-pad XMOS group and the 8-pad group are recorded as separate connectors because of the wider gap between them; the image does not show whether they belong to one physical header.
notes: Labels copied as printed on the blue callouts (lowercase '3v3' and '5v'); the character after 'XMOS_X' is a narrow zero, distinct from the O in 'XMOS'. Square pads (first pad of the bottom-left and bottom-right groups, and the MUTE pad) are not treated as pin-1 marks (rule 9). Skipped: a 2x3 cluster of unlabeled pads partly hidden behind the middle-row callouts, other unlabeled pads/test points, the Usr and Mute buttons and the RGB/Mute LEDs. The left part of the board is cut off in the image.
